synthesis.how_work_enters:
AUTHORING PATH (verified by reading each authority; nothing on the daily workspace authors a node or records acceptance -- both are repository edits that reach srv1 by deploy).

1. DESIGN FIRST, as a plan module. A plan is `gunbc.plan` `Plan { slug, title, body: List<MarkdownBlock>, retirement: PlanRetirement, projection: PlanProjection }` declared as `data <name>_plan: Plan` in `dag/gunbc/plans/<name>.dag`, body built with `gunbc.plans.md_helpers` (h2/h3/p/li/ul/ol/quote/cell/row), retirement `PlanRetiresWhen { condition: unbound_dissolution(description: ...) }` (`std.dissolution`; every one of the 72 plans is unbound, none bound), projection `PlanProjectsCommittedMarkdown` (docs/plans/<slug>.md generated and committed) or `PlanIsAuthorityOnly { ruling }` (no markdown). It must be appended to `gunbc.plan_registry_batch_g` `batch_g_plans` (the roster `gunbc.plan_registry` `all_plans`), or it is generated by nothing and checked by no witness (seven unrostered plan modules exist today). Optional governance row in `gunbc.plan_governance` `plan_governance_rows` (root `v2-compiler-architecture`; admitted only if functional/rooted/acyclic/complete). Claims the plan makes about symbols go in a `List<DeclarationRef>` roster (`gunbc.plans.v2_corpus_self_host` `v2_corpus_self_host_ratchet_bindings` pattern) so the citation wall resolves them. Witnesses: `test.claim.plan_lens_witness` (every_registered_plan_has_retirement, every_registered_plan_is_titled) and `test.claim.plan_governance_witness`.

2. THE NODE: one `roadmap_node(...)` call appended inside `gunbc.roadmap_authority` `declared_roadmap_nodes` (the one constructor; `gunbc.roadmap_model` `RoadmapNode`). Arguments: `identity` MINTED (`gunbc.roadmap_model` `roadmap_node_identity_law`: never derived from slug/position; `rn_` + 26 base32 chars -- the identities below were minted from /dev/urandom; there is no minting tool), `id` = the slug and the `/issue/<id>` route (`gunbc.roadmap_issue_location` `issue_page_path`), `owner` = a lane name (free String), `carriers: carrier(path: ...)` = the plan module path or subject file (a path String labelled "authority"; nothing resolves it against disk), `line: ticket(t: fields(headline, boundary, displaced_cost, first_slice, red_control, out_of_scope, handback))` -- all seven non-empty (`test.claim.roadmap_authority` `witness_every_declared_row_is_complete_unsigned_ticket`), `first_slice` free of the strings "PR #", "session/", "CI run" because `fields()` prefixes it into `current_state` (`witness_authority_contains_no_mutable_execution_ledger`); dated notes go through `updated(t:, on:, note:)` only. `dispatch: dispatchable()` (= Dispatchable { repo: "gunbc", acceptance: ManualAcceptance }). `execution: bound(contract: gunbc_claim_execution_contract(entry: "<witness file>" as FilePath, function: "<test fn>" as NonEmptyStr))` or `gunbc_claims_execution_contract(entry:, functions: [...])` (`gunbc.roadmap_execution_contract`; one GunbcClaimValidation per test fn; `witness_every_binding_carries_a_validation`). `parent: in_project(project: "<existing slug>", contribution: "...")` whose walk reaches `gunbc-project-root` (`gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_lineage` `lineage_walk_in`; `test.claim.roadmap_nesting_witness` every_node_that_states_a_parent_reaches_the_one_admitted_root). `centering: plan(text: "...")` = the worker's near-complete plan (`gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_centering`; `dispatch_centering_preamble` is prepended once per brief). Prerequisites are `edge(child:, parent:)` rows in `declared_roadmap_edges` -- an edge HOLDS the child until the parent has an acceptance receipt, so edge only to what the node genuinely waits on. Readiness is the one predicate `gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_readiness` `node_readiness`: ReadyToDispatch iff no GapSuperseded/GapAccepted/GapInReview/GapParent/GapRoot/GapCentering/GapDispatch/GapContract/GapNotAgentWork/GapDependencies.

3. THE RED WITNESS, authored in the same change: `dag/test/claim/<area>/<slug>_witness_test.dag`, module name mirroring the path, `data live_tree_disposition: LiveTreeDisposition = SubstrateInputsOnly`, one test fn per clause of the bar over PLANTED inputs, exemplar `dag/test/claim/closing/ci_executed_coverage_receipt_closing_contract_witness_test.dag`, authority-row exemplar `id: "shell-dag-cron-entry-line-builder"` (`gunbc.roadmap_authority` `closing_contract_exemplar_bound_row`). For implementation nodes the witness is RED at launch and the worker makes it green; a node bound to no contract is NotReady (GapContract) and, if that is its only gap, the projection mints a derived "Write the closing check" task (`closing_contract_task_for`).

4. PROJECTIONS: ROADMAP.md is `gunbc.generated_artifact` `RoadmapArtifact` -> `gunbc.roadmap_authority` `expected_roadmap_md`; plan markdown is `PlanArtifact` -> `gunbc.plan` `plan_generation`. Regenerate with `gunbc run --source-root dag --source-root src/v2 --entry dag/gunbc/instruments/generated_artifact_gate.dag --function main_wet` and adjudicate with `--function main` (`tools.generated_artifact_gate`). SINCE #13658 NOTHING ON THE REQUIRED PATH COMPARES THESE OR RUNS THE ROADMAP WITNESSES (`gunbc.rung_drop` `v1_required_lanes_withdrawn` population members 1 and 2), so the author runs the roadmap and plan witnesses locally before pushing (`gunbc run --source-root dag --source-root src/v2 --entry <witness file> --function <fn>`: the ProcessExit refusal prints the Bool -- verified on `gunbc.roadmap_identity` `active_identity_count`, which printed 225). A malformed node otherwise surfaces only when the belt projects it (`frontier_sets_projection` refuses the whole roadmap).

5. LANDING: PR -> merge queue -> the ONE required job `witnesses` (`gunbc.compiler_gate_workflow` `compiler_gate_required_job_id`) emits and builds the two products fresh; it judges neither the roadmap nor the plans.

6. REACHING THE SITE: `gunbc.fleet_revision_acceptance` admits the landed revision under `gunbc.required_ci_contract_epoch`; the live deploy (`gunbc.live_deploy.apply` `live_deploy_apply_srv1` over a `CandidateRelease`, the `LiveDeploy` scope of fleet-converge, `gunbc.live_deploy.repository_convergence` installs the candidate COMMIT) restarts gunbc-roadmap.service; each belt tick (`gunbc.roadmap_belt_tick_cli`, 60 s) replays `dag/gunbc/roadmap/roadmap_acceptance_event_history.jsonl`, projects the authority (`roadmap_authority_projection`), renders the daily page (`gunbc.roadmap_served_observation` `served_observation_daily_surface_over`) and the row's readiness.

7. DISPATCH: production spawn mode is ManualReady (`gunbc.roadmap_belt` `roadmap_belt_production_spawn_mode`; the timer's cause is refused by `gunbc.roadmap_launch_admission` `launch_gate_cause`), so the operator starts work by POST `/dispatch/<id>` (`gunbc.roadmap_serve` `serve_dispatch_handler_response_over`) or by assigning the Fabric principal on `/issue/<id>` (`serve_assignment_launch_follow_through_over`). `launch_admission` (instance > transition > revision > node > readiness > live > capacity > cause) -> `gunbc.roadmap_belt_actuate` `belt_actuate_spawn_for_instance` -> harness worker (`gunbc.harness.harness_cli` `harness_worker_cli`) with the brief (`gunbc.roadmap_dispatch_actuator` `dispatch_brief_for_origin` = preamble + centering + the ticket fields + commands_to_run from the contract).

8. RETURN: capture (`.gunbc-submission.json`, `gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_submission`) -> verify (`belt_verify_run_and_persist` runs each GunbcClaimValidation as `gunbc run <roots> --entry <entry> --function <fn> --claim-run`, `gunbc.roadmap_execution_contract` `validation_operation_command`) -> review (`gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_review_function`) -> publish PR (`gunbc.roadmap_publication_helper`) -> ResultReturned on the issue (`gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_result_returned`).

9. ACCEPTANCE: a merged PR completes nothing. The operator appends `AcceptanceRecorded { RoadmapAcceptanceReceipt { node, criteria_digest (gunbc.roadmap_model roadmap_criteria_digest over brief+red_control+handback), red_control: RedControlExecuted { witness_module, witness_fn, executed_on }, handback: HandbackDelivered { first_artifact, ... }, accepted_by, accepted_on } }` to the JSONL carrier (`gunbc.roadmap_acceptance_history_carrier`) by PR; no serve route or CLI constructs it (only `gunbc.roadmap_model` does). Children unblock on the next projection.
synthesis.minimum_pr_shape: One PR adding one designed task touches, at minimum: (a) `dag/gunbc/roadmap/roadmap_authority.dag` -- one `roadmap_node(...)` row inside `declared_roadmap_nodes` (identity minted, dispatchable(), bound(contract: ...), in_project(...), plan(...)) plus zero or more `edge(child:, parent:)` rows inside `declared_roadmap_edges`; (b) the RED acceptance witness `dag/test/claim/<area>/<slug>_witness_test.dag` the contract names (module name = path, `live_tree_disposition = SubstrateInputsOnly`, planted inputs, one positive control); (c) the regenerated `ROADMAP.md` (`tools.generated_artifact_gate` `main_wet`), because `test.claim.roadmap_authority` `witness_authority_document_carries_every_active_declared_row` and `roadmap_gate_test` pin it; and, when the task is a design, (d) `dag/gunbc/plans/<name>.dag` + one import and one list entry in `dag/gunbc/plan_registry_batch_g.dag` + the regenerated `docs/plans/<slug>.md` if the projection arm is committed. No change to the identity registry (derived), to `gunbc.roadmap_sizing` (size is derived and today SizingNotDerivable), or to the dashboard. Before pushing, run locally (no required step runs them since #13658): the roadmap witnesses (`test.claim.roadmap_authority`, `roadmap_identity_witness_test`, `roadmap_nesting_witness`, `roadmap_alignment_witness`, `roadmap_centering_witness`, `roadmap_readiness_witness`, `roadmap_gate_test`), the plan witnesses (`test.claim.plan_lens_witness`, `test.claim.plan_governance_witness`), and `generated_artifact_gate main`. The exemplar bound row to copy is `id: "shell-dag-cron-entry-line-builder"`. The node appears on srv1 only after the landed revision is deployed (live_deploy) -- which today also needs the srv1 directory fix (see blockers).

entries.title: Execute the one-file native route through the built SourceRootEvalDriver and take its first typed terminal as the frontier
entries.design_summary: Item 4. The driver is std.compiler_entry SourceRootEvalDriver (reads a universe of qualified test identities plus declared roots, prepares once per module, evals each member to one typed verdict: v2.compiler.native_test_vocabulary NativeTestVerdict = NativeTestPassed | NativeTestReturnedFalse | NativeTestReturnedOther | NativeTestRefused { stage: Context|Prepare|Entry|Eval, diagnostics }, or a NativeTestFileRefusal chain whose fatal link is the last). The operator's phrase is 'one-file full native route'; the driver's contract makes the one file the one universe member, run over the declared roots. The frontier is OBSERVED: the derived reading (sharp-raven-438) that extdeps.filesystem.filesystem_io refuses in normalize as body_lowering_reason_service_realization_unreachable (gunbc.recurring_failure_mode service_interface_member_has_no_carrier; gunbc.compiler_frontend_program_status xl2_prerequisites ServiceModuleLowering) is a hypothesis the run confirms or refutes; it is not committed from source reasoning. The row shape follows gunbc.native_frontier_roster (RosterUnminted | RosterMinted + NativeFrontierMintReceipt { tested_tree, preparation_seed_identity, emitted_closure_identity, executable_identity }). Ordering consequence: if the terminal is that refusal, XL-2 3c (xl2-body-lowering's ServiceModuleLowering) precedes the parked N7 inference chain, expressed as edge(child: native-seven, parent: xl2-body-lowering).

entries.title: The native obligation is one population, judged by one built SourceRootEvalDriver: a green set that only grows and exactly one observed frontier
entries.design_summary: Item 3. Needs the new plan module gunbc.plans.native_obligation_population. The population is SEPARATE from gunbc.emitted_subject_build_gate emitted_subject_build_rows (which stays the two compiler products) and is executed on the `witnesses` job by the self-host product's built driver (one STEP, not a job -- the roster is closed, operator ruling Q4 2026-09-30). Members are gunbc.witness_v2_native_route NativeRouteTestIdentity rows; the monotone contract shape already exists in gunbc.native_frontier_debt / gunbc.native_frontier_roster (RosterUnminted today; a debt roster over a minted universe, re-minted only from a run's [native-frontier-roster] proposal) -- the plan must rule whether the green set is the complement of that roster over its minted universe (reuse) or replaces the debt roster in one root cut (replacement migration, delete-first). Eligibility: a label whose standing is judged by the host is ineligible -- gunbc.native_claim_program native_claim_program_standing and the native-serve probe standing are 'evaluated by the host and mapped through cli_run classify_exit' (gunbc.native_claim_program_seed_growth, gunbc.native_serve_program_seed_growth), i.e. through the v1 interpreter, so gunbc.target_binding NativeClaimProgramProducer / NativeServeProgramProducer labels refuse until their adjudication is native. reader_maps.summary: The roadmap authority (`gunbc.roadmap_authority`, dag/gunbc/roadmap/roadmap_authority.dag) declares no record types of its own: it is a roster of ~225 `roadmap_node(...)` calls (`declared_roadmap_nodes` = a literal list concatenated with `guarantee_ladder_nodes`), ~137 `edge(child:, parent:)` rows (`declared_roadmap_edges` + `guarantee_ladder_edges`), per-node execution-contract constructor fns, and the frontier/projection folds. The record is `gunbc.roadmap_model RoadmapNode` with ten fields: `identity` (minted `rn_…` brand, never derived from slug/position), `node` (the slug, also the `/issue/<slug>` route key), `line: RoadmapItem` (five arms; every live row is `TicketLine { done, ticket: TicketFields }` with headline/brief/displaced_cost/current_state/first_slice/red_control/out_of_scope/handback/updates/authored_on/last_verified_on; one row is `SupersededLine`), `carriers: List<Pointer{label,path}>`, `dispatch: WorkItemDispatch` (`NotDispatchable | Dispatchable{repo, acceptance}`), `execution: WorkItemExecutionContract` (`ExecutionContractUnspecified | ExecutionContract{validations,…} | NotAgentWork{mode}`), `owner: String` (free-form lane name, 20 distinct values), `signoff: Signoff` (always `Unsigned` on declared rows — acceptance is NOT a node field), `parent: NodeParent?` (`MemberOf{project, contribution} | AdmittedRoot | Closes{target}`), `centering: NonEmptyStr?` (the inline worker plan). There is no status enum: status is DERIVED. Accepted = exactly one live `RoadmapAcceptanceReceipt` (replayed from dag/gunbc/roadmap/roadmap_acceptance_event_history.jsonl, 17 events) whose `criteria_digest` equals the hash of the row's current brief+red_control+handback and whose evidence arms are `RedControlExecuted`/`HandbackDelivered`; active = declared − accepted − withheld; superseded = `SupersededLine`; in-review = `done` without a receipt. A node references a DESIGN/PLAN three ways, none typed: (1) `carriers` are repo-relative path strings labelled "authority" (36 rows point at docs/plans/compiler-guarantee-recovery-gap-analysis.md; others at docs/plans/*.md, `.dag` plan modules such as dag/gunbc/plans/demand_engine_program.dag, or source files) — never resolved against the live tree by a roster witness; (2) `centering` is the inline near-complete plan (29 of ~225 rows carry one); (3) DESIGN.md is never a node — it is the terminal `decl_ref(gunbc.design_document, design_document)` at the top of every alignment chain (`gunbc.roadmap_alignment alignment_root_pointer`). Dependencies are `RoadmapEdge{child, parent}` = child waits for parent's acceptance receipt; nesting is the separate `parent` field walked by `gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_lineage lineage_walk_in` to the single `AdmittedRoot` (`gunbc-project-root`, four member projects v2-compiler-live / fabric-bringup / debt-payoff / factory). Ready vs blocked is ONE predicate, `gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_readiness node_readiness`: `ReadyToDispatch` iff zero gaps from the ordered list GapSuperseded, GapAccepted, GapInReview, GapParent, GapRoot, GapCentering, GapDispatch, GapContract, GapNotAgentWork, GapDependencies{blockers} — the dispatcher (`gunbc.roadmap_launch_admission LaunchNotReady{missing}`), the page, and the derived "write the closing check" task minting (`closing_contract_task_for`, only when the contract is the SOLE gap) all read that value. Malformed rows are refused at three rungs: by construction (required identity/node/line/carriers/owner, NonEmptyStr brands, one parent field, signoff fixed Unsigned), by the floor witnesses in dag/test/claim/roadmap/ (unique ids and identities, edge endpoints exist, acyclic, every ticket row complete/unsigned/open with a carrier, owner and gunbc+ManualAcceptance dispatch, no dates or execution state in standing fields, every bound contract has ≥1 validation, every stated parent reaches gunbc-project-root), and at projection time (`frontier_sets_projection` refuses the whole roadmap on an undeclared/ambiguous/superseded/digest-mismatched receipt join).

facts.fact: The authority module imports its record types rather than declaring them: RoadmapNode, RoadmapNodeIdentity, RoadmapEdge, Pointer, RoadmapNodeId, NodeParent, WorkItemDispatch and the acceptance-receipt vocabulary come from gunbc.roadmap_model; TicketFields/TicketLine/SupersededLine/Unsigned/RoadmapItem from gunbc.roadmap_status; ExecutionContractUnspecified and the contract constructors from gunbc.roadmap_execution_contract; lineage_walk_in/lineage_index from gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_lineage; node_readiness/readiness_only_contract_missing from gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_readiness.

RoadmapNode has exactly ten fields: identity: RoadmapNodeIdentity, node: RoadmapNodeId, line: RoadmapItem, carriers: List<Pointer>, dispatch: WorkItemDispatch, execution: WorkItemExecutionContract, owner: String, signoff: Signoff, parent: NodeParent?, centering: NonEmptyStr?.

RoadmapNodeId and RoadmapNodeIdentity are both `NonEmptyStr where brand(...)`; identity is MINTED, never derived -- slug, title, criteria digest, containment position, dependency neighbourhood, declaration order and file position are forbidden identity inputs, and identity is a required field so a node without one is unwritable.

Pointer is `{ label: String, path: String }`; the authority's `carrier(path:)` helper produces `[Pointer { label: "authority", path }]`, and derived closing-contract tasks add label "witness" and copy the target's carriers under label "subject".

WorkItemDispatch = NotDispatchable | Dispatchable { repo: String, acceptance: Acceptance } with Acceptance = PrsMerged | ManualAcceptance; acceptance names the evidence a worker returns for review, not the lifecycle verdict. Size is no longer a node field: gunbc.roadmap_sizing derives it from the ticket and today always answers SizingNotDerivable (deriver unbuilt).

WorkItemExecutionContract = ExecutionContractUnspecified | ExecutionContract { validations: List<ValidationOperation>, extra_capabilities, path_scope: AttemptPathScope, source_roots: ClaimSourceRootLayout } | NotAgentWork { mode: OperatorExclusiveMode | ExternalLeadMode | CalendarObservationMode }. ValidationOperation = GunbcClaimValidation { entry: FilePath, function: NonEmptyStr } | CargoTestValidation { filter } | CargoFmtValidation | ClosingContractAuthoringValidation { target }. Every declared binding in the authority goes through gunbc_claim_execution_contract / gunbc_claims_execution_contract (one GunbcClaimValidation per named test fn).

contract_closure is the one binding law: ExecutionContractUnspecified -> ContractDeclaresNoValidation; ExecutionContract with [] validations -> ContractClosesNothing; NotAgentWork -> ContractNotAgentWork; otherwise ContractCloses. Readiness maps the first two to GapContract{detail} and the third to GapNotAgentWork.

NodeParent = MemberOf { project: String, contribution: NonEmptyStr } | AdmittedRoot | Closes { target: String }. One field is one parent, so a member claimed by two projects has no constructor; the former keyed membership roster (declared_roadmap_memberships) was deleted and gunbc.roadmap_nesting roadmap_memberships_of is now a projection of the rows.

RoadmapItem = DerivableLine { prs: List<Int>, title, description } | AuthoredLine { done, content } | PlainLine { content } | SupersededLine { by, content } | TicketLine { done: Bool, ticket: TicketFields }. TicketFields = { headline, brief, displaced_cost, current_state, first_slice, red_control, out_of_scope, handback, updates: List<TicketUpdate { on, note }>, authored_on, last_verified_on } (all String).

Signoff = Unsigned | SignedOff { by, works: RedControlEvidence, scope_equivalent: HandbackEvidence, as_expected: Bool }; RedControlEvidence = RedControlNotRun | RedControlExecuted { witness_module, witness_fn, executed_on } (NonEmptyStr); HandbackEvidence = HandbackNotDelivered | HandbackDelivered { first_artifact, further_artifacts }. The constructor roadmap_node hard-codes signoff: Unsigned, so no declared row is ever SignedOff; acceptance lives in receipts, not on the node.

THE ONE NODE CONSTRUCTOR: roadmap_node(identity: String, id: String, owner: String, carriers: List<Pointer>, line: RoadmapItem, dispatch: WorkItemDispatch? = none, execution: WorkItemExecutionContract? = none, parent: NodeParent? = none, centering: NonEmptyStr? = none) -> RoadmapNode; absent dispatch reads NotDispatchable, absent execution reads ExecutionContractUnspecified; a row that does not pass a fact is simply NOT READY (operator ruling 2026-09-30).

Row helpers: ticket(t) -> TicketLine { done: false, ticket: t }; dispatchable() -> Present(Dispatchable { repo: "gunbc", acceptance: ManualAcceptance }); bound(contract); in_project(project, contribution) -> Present(MemberOf{...}); admitted_root(); plan(text) -> Present(text as NonEmptyStr); edge(child, parent) -> RoadmapEdge; updated(t, on, note) appends a TicketUpdate to the updates thread (dated status notes go there, never into first_slice).

fields(headline, boundary, displaced_cost, first_slice, red_control, out_of_scope, handback) builds a task ticket: brief = boundary, current_state = "Unaccepted; next executable slice: " + first_slice, updates = [], authored_on = last_verified_on = "". level_fields(headline, boundary, approach, red_control, displaced_cost, handback) builds a project/milestone ticket: current_state = first_slice = approach and out_of_scope is the fixed sentence "No executable work lives on this node: its dispatch fields are stubs, it is never dispatched, and its bar is met only through its members." (38 rows use level_fields).

declared_roadmap_nodes() = concat([ ...literal roadmap_node rows... ], guarantee_ladder_nodes()); declared_roadmap_edges() = concat([ ...edge rows... ], guarantee_ladder_edges()). The guarantee-ladder nodes are ordinary declared nodes under owner compiler-guarantee, kept in a second fn only for file organisation (a section-local list that bypassed the authority was the 2026-07-31 ghost-node defect).

Population by grep (not executed): 225 `id: "..."` rows across both node lists, 137 `edge(child:` rows, 151 rows pass dispatch: dispatchable(), 31 pass execution: bound(...), 223 pass parent: in_project(...), exactly 1 passes parent: admitted_root() (gunbc-project-root), 29 pass centering: plan(...), 109 carry at least one updated(...) note, 1 row is a SupersededLine (entry-graph-union-construction, owner "", carriers []). The re-derivable instrument for the node count is gunbc.roadmap_identity identity_count / active_identity_count.

owner is a free String naming a LANE, not an assignee ("Owner here is the LANE's identity, not an assignee: nodes are unbound until dispatch binds a session"). Distinct values on the tree: self-host, compiler-guarantee, fleet, debt, harness, namespace, shell, primitive-egress, ci-control, buyer-review, source-intent, ci-cost, v1-performance, language-integrity, generated-artifact, program (the root), operator, deduction, ci-observation, and "" (the superseded row). The program/project vocabulary is the slug of another node, passed as in_project(project: <slug>, contribution: <why this child advances it>). gunbc-project-root is the only AdmittedRoot; its approach names four member projects: v2-compiler-live, fabric-bringup, debt-payoff, factory. Other project slugs in use include compiler-guarantee, ci-end-to-end-execution, v2-emitter-production, v1-deletion-program, namespace-unique-on-chain, fabric-application-authority, shell-typed-invocation, vm-service, demand-engine, v2-shared-type-check, v2-frontend, dp-m1..m5 milestones, customer-workspace-service, managed-identity-access-dependencies, factory-on-fabric, harness-recursive-alignment, native-route-to-live, microvm-runtime-durable-state. A project is simply a node that passes a parent and no centering or contract and has members (lineage_has_members).

There is no status field. Acceptance is a durable typed receipt: RoadmapAcceptanceReceipt { node, criteria_digest: Fnv1a64Structural, red_control: RedControlEvidence, handback: HandbackEvidence, accepted_by, accepted_on }; criteria_digest = roadmap_criteria_digest over the row's brief, red_control and handback, so editing any of those three after acceptance makes the stored receipt stop matching and the node returns to the active set. node_receipts_accept requires EXACTLY ONE matching receipt per node with RedControlExecuted and HandbackDelivered.

The single acceptance authority is the append-only JSONL carrier dag/gunbc/roadmap/roadmap_acceptance_event_history.jsonl (17 lines), events RoadmapAcceptanceEvent = AcceptanceRecorded { receipt } | AcceptanceRevoked { exact_prior_receipt, disposition: AcceptanceNodeReopensActiveFrontier | AcceptanceNodeRemainsSuperseded, reason, revoked_by, revoked_on }; replay_acceptance_history refuses (Absent) a second live receipt for a node, a revocation of a receipt that is not live, or a duplicate revocation. First line: {"variant":"acceptance_recorded","receipt":{"node":"2-scm-git-upstream-model","criteria_digest":"b3747b95baf099cc",...}}.

frontier_sets_projection(history) is the one fold producing both frontier halves: accepted = declared nodes with a matching live receipt; withheld = node_ids_held_off_active_frontier (revoked with RemainsSuperseded). It REFUSES the whole roadmap (FrontierSetsProjectionRefused{detail}) on: remains-superseded-revocation-on-{non-superseded,undeclared,ambiguous-declared}-node, acceptance-history-unreplayable, live-receipt-on-superseded-line, live-receipt-does-not-match-declared-node, live-receipt-on-undeclared-node, live-receipt-on-ambiguous-declared-node. Active nodes = declared minus accepted minus withheld; active edges drop any edge touching an accepted or withheld endpoint.

Dependencies: RoadmapEdge { child: RoadmapNodeId, parent: RoadmapNodeId } means the child waits until the parent has an acceptance receipt ("AN EDGE HOLDS A CHILD UNTIL ITS PARENT HAS AN ACCEPTANCE RECEIPT, so a parent is chosen for what it OWES"). Edges never assign project ownership; the first declared parent is used only as the presentation primary parent, and roadmap_parent_ids keeps every prerequisite. unmet_parents_in(n, parent_index, accepted_set) lists the parents not yet accepted; readiness turns a non-empty list into GapDependencies { blockers }.

Machine consumers must read projected_roadmap_dependency_edges_projection (declared active edges PLUS derived closing-contract edges child=<node>, parent=<node>-closing-contract), never declared_roadmap_edges alone.

Nesting is walked by lineage_walk_in over a lineage_index of the node list with fuel = count(nodes)+1; results LineageRooted { ids } | LineageNoParent { walked, at } | LineageUndeclared { walked, node_id } | LineageCyclic { node_id }. A Closes node's chain is its target's chain with the task standing in at the task level. The graph has no exclusion-edge vocabulary: the staggering constraint between same-file shell-dag pairs lives only in their centering plans.

READINESS IS ONE PREDICATE: node_readiness(node, lineage, unmet_parents, merged) -> ReadyToDispatch | NotReady { missing: List<ReadinessGap> }, gaps in fixed order: GapSuperseded{by} (line is SupersededLine), GapAccepted (signoff_accepts -- never true on declared rows), GapInReview (item_is_done: TicketLine.done or all DerivableLine PRs merged), GapParent (parent Absent), GapRoot{detail} (lineage not Rooted), GapCentering (centering Absent), GapDispatch (NotDispatchable), GapContract{detail}, GapNotAgentWork{mode}, GapDependencies{blockers}. Labels rendered on the page: superseded / accepted / in review / parent / root / centering / dispatch binding / contract / not agent work (...) / dependencies; readiness_text = "ready" or "not ready: missing centering, contract".

Three surfaces consume that one value: the dispatcher's launch admission refuses with LaunchNotReady { missing } (launch_node_readiness -> GateRefused), the page renders SchedulingNotReady { missing } (gunbc.roadmap_presentation work_scheduling), and the derived closing-contract minting mints only when readiness_only_contract_missing (count(missing)==1 and it is GapContract).

closing_contract_task_for(n) derives a dispatchable task for a node whose ONLY gap is its contract: identity = <identity>-closing-contract, node = <slug>-closing-contract, headline "Write the closing check for: <headline>", carriers = authority file + witness path dag/test/claim/closing/<slug_with_underscores>_closing_contract_witness_test.dag + the target's carriers as "subject", dispatch Dispatchable{gunbc, ManualAcceptance}, execution = closing_contract_authoring_contract(target), owner = target's owner, parent = Closes { target }, centering = target's centering. The exemplar bound row the brief tells workers to copy is id "shell-dag-cron-entry-line-builder". Derived tasks are added at the PROJECTION only, never to the active set.

Field meanings (this is the row gunbc.roadmap_authority names as closing_contract_exemplar_bound_row, i.e. the shape every bound row copies; all nine constructor arguments present):
- identity: the minted durable RoadmapNodeIdentity (rn_ prefix); survives renames, never derived from the slug or position; what acceptance receipts, sizing and tombstones key on.
- id: the RoadmapNodeId slug; the /issue/<id> route, the edge endpoint name, the in_project(project:) target other rows cite.
- owner: the lane (not a person) -- here "shell".
- carriers: Pointer{label:"authority", path} -- the subject file (or plan doc) the work lives in; copied as "subject" into a derived closing-contract task.
- line: ticket(t: fields(...)) -> TicketLine{done:false, ticket}: headline (the page title), boundary -> TicketFields.brief (what is in scope), displaced_cost (why it is worth paying for), first_slice (also prefixed into current_state as "Unaccepted; next executable slice: ..."), red_control (the perturbation that must go red; hashed into the acceptance criteria digest together with brief and handback), out_of_scope (exclusions), handback (what comes back; also hashed). updates/authored_on/last_verified_on are left empty by fields().
- dispatch: dispatchable() = Dispatchable{repo:"gunbc", acceptance: ManualAcceptance}; absent -> NotDispatchable -> GapDispatch.
- execution: bound(contract: ...) -> ExecutionContract with one GunbcClaimValidation{entry, function} (the test fn whose green closes the node); absent -> ExecutionContractUnspecified -> GapContract (and, if that is the only gap, a derived "write the closing check" task is minted).
- parent: in_project(project, contribution) -> MemberOf; the lineage walk must reach gunbc-project-root (AdmittedRoot) or the node has GapRoot; absent -> GapParent.
- centering: plan(text) -> the worker's supplied plan, prepended with dispatch_centering_preamble in every brief; absent -> GapCentering.
- signoff: not an argument -- always Unsigned; acceptance is a receipt in roadmap_acceptance_event_history.jsonl.
- blocked vs ready: this row is ready only if no declared edge(child:"shell-dag-cron-entry-line-builder", parent: X) has X unaccepted (GapDependencies) and none of the other gaps fire.

reader_maps.summary:
HOW A ROADMAP NODE BECOMES DISPATCHED WORK (gunbc, worktree smart-gull-336, plus live srv1 reads over ssh).

1. WHAT THE BELT TICK DOES EACH CADENCE. The cadence is gunbc.live_deploy.belt_cadence belt_tick_cadence = 60s, realized as a systemd timer with OnUnitInactiveSec (measured from the previous run's END, so ticks never overlap), OnBootSec=2min, AccuracySec=5s, and the service's TimeoutStartSec = belt_tick_run_bound = 2700s. In THIS worktree the belt service (gunbc.live_deploy.emit live_deploy_belt_service_unit_file) runs `gunbc run ... --entry dag/gunbc/roadmap/roadmap_belt_tick_cli.dag --function belt_launch_enqueue_cli`, which only ENQUEUES the instance's single LaunchObligation unit; the launch itself is gunbc.roadmap_belt_tick_cli belt_run_once_cli -> belt_run_once_cli_in -> gunbc.roadmap_belt_actuate belt_run_once_in. That fold: loads the acceptance event history (roadmap_acceptance_event_history_load), projects the roadmap authority (roadmap_authority_projection), builds spawn_frontier(doc, merged: authored_merged_prs()), then belt_tick_for_instance: (a) one staged host observation belt_launch_host_standing_complete (instance actuating? deployment transition clear? deployed revision == desired? live session census), (b) belt_tick_launch_pass = belt_reconcile (desired = frontier.ready, observed = live owned sessions keyed by node id; upserts in plan order, NOT truncated to capacity) + belt_tick_admit (a fold of launch_admission(cause: Timer, reserved) over every upsert), (c) belt_tick_spawn_after_settlement (session placement settlement runs first; then only BeltLaunchDecided rows reach belt_actuate_spawn_member), (d) teardowns of departed/stale sessions, (e) belt_discover_for_instance (bounded anti-entropy: finds attempts with outstanding obligations and hands at most belt_discovery_attempt_bound=8 to their units). It then persists the BeltTickReceipt (roadmap-belt-tick-receipt/v7, instance receipts dir belt-last-tick.json) and enqueues the record-moved instance obligations (metering, result-return, served observation, dogfood-start, snapshot-census), each in its own unit. The "belt demoted" ruling (2026-09-22; docs/plans/belt-event-driven-obligations.md) moved capture/verify/review/audit/publish OFF the tick into per-attempt obligation units woken by the worker's unit exit (path unit on the exit inbox -> belt_exit_drain_cli) and by discovery.

THE KEY FACT: the tick does NOT start work in production. gunbc.roadmap_belt roadmap_belt_production_spawn_mode = ManualReady, and gunbc.roadmap_launch_admission launch_gate_cause refuses cause Timer in ManualReady with LaunchCauseNotPermitted. The timer's launch pass still folds every ready node through admission so the receipt shows what it WOULD have started and why not; only teardown, discovery and the obligations proceed. The live srv1 receipt (2026-10-09T21:16:58Z) confirms spawn_mode "manual_ready", launches [].

2. WHICH NODES IT SELECTS. Eligibility is ONE predicate chain. Frontier (gunbc.roadmap_spawner next_spawnable): dispatch is Dispatchable{repo, acceptance}, not accepted (signoff_accepts), not superseded, every parent edge closed (parent accepted or superseded). Admission (gunbc.roadmap_launch_admission launch_ledger_rows, in order): instance > transition > revision > node > readiness > live > capacity > cause. Readiness is gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_readiness node_readiness: gaps GapSuperseded, GapAccepted, GapInReview, GapParent (no parent), GapRoot (lineage not rooted), GapCentering (node.centering absent), GapDispatch, GapContract (execution contract absent or closes nothing), GapNotAgentWork, GapDependencies. Live: no running/stale/unobserved/multiple session for the node. Capacity: launch_gate_capacity with BeltCapacity.max_concurrent = 3 (roadmap_belt_default_capacity) and `reserved` counting launches already admitted in the same fold, so capacity is admitted as a prefix in plan order. Cause: Operator passes in ManualReady; Timer only in AutomaticReady. Ordering is the authored document order of frontier.ready; there is no priority sort in the belt (gunbc.roadmap_priority exists but is not consulted by belt_tick_desired_candidates). Note authored_merged_prs() returns a literal [] so the merged-PR/in-review reading never fires.

3. WHAT IT HANDS A WORKER. Operator entry points, both cause Operator: POST /dispatch/<node_id> (gunbc.roadmap_serve serve_dispatch_handler_response_over -> belt_dispatch_node_for_instance_over(request: LaunchAutonomous, executor)) and the issue page's assign route: assigning the Fabric principal (serve_assignment_launch_follow_through_over) appends a Claimed event to the issue's event log and dispatches with LaunchForClaim{node, claim: that event id}; a human assignee never dispatches. Spawn path (belt_actuate_spawn_for_instance): footprint admission -> dispatch_environment_admit(node.execution, instance.execution_environment) producing the admission receipt (capability probes: git, tmux, sh, tee, jq, env, install, gunbc claim runner) -> dispatch_actuator_selection_for_request (default executor = the gunbc HARNESS, GunbcHarnessProvider; vendors claude/codex/cursor only when the executor word names them) -> provider preflight -> continuation decision (fresh from base / continue from prior attempt's branch / convene supervisor) -> alignment resolution + binding -> dispatch_spawn_commands_for_resolved_instance -> session placement grant (gunbc.roadmap_session_placement: memory from the host's agent-session pool, term 14400s, cpu 8000m/4096 tasks) -> belt_spawn_admitted: git worktree add (branch dispatch_branch_name, base = instance.dispatch_base_ref = origin/main on srv1), attempt-state-prepare, attempt state initialize (admission receipt, LaunchIdentity, alignment binding, request binding, process fingerprint), attempt-current pointer, container create+start -> Spawned. The container is a transient systemd unit for the harness (SystemdUnitContainer with MemoryMax from the grant) or tmux for vendor CLIs. THE BRIEF (gunbc.roadmap_dispatch_actuator dispatch_brief_for_origin) = continuation prefix (if any) + dispatch_centering_preamble (gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_centering) + "Centering plan for this node:" + node_centering_plan_text(node) + fill_dispatch_brief(gunbc.roadmap_spawner dispatch_brief_template, fields). Fields (dispatch_brief_fields_for_environment): node_id; TicketFields.displaced_cost/current_state/first_slice/red_control/out_of_scope/handback when the node's line is a TicketLine (title stubs otherwise); paths from node.carriers; commands_to_run = execution_contract_validation_summary(node.execution) i.e. the contract's ValidationOperations; expected_artifact literal. The harness worker (gunbc.harness.harness_cli harness_worker_cli) receives worktree, brief, events path, repo root, attempt identity and alignment fingerprint; binds a serving seat (local vLLM backend) and runs one bounded turn with the brief as the prompt. IT IS NOT A DASHBOARD WORK ITEM: nothing under dag/ references `dashboard-ops` or `work-items` (only three recurring_failure_mode files mention the tool, and two docs/plans); the belt's unit of work is an ATTEMPT (node_id + attempt_key) with a state directory, worktree, branch and launch record under the instance root. "Work item" in this codebase means gunbc.roadmap_model WorkItemDispatch / gunbc.roadmap_execution_contract WorkItemExecutionContract, roadmap node fields, not the sessions' work-items tool.

4. HOW COMPLETION AND PRs FLOW BACK. Per attempt, in eligibility order (gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_belt_obligation belt_attempt_obligation_order): capture -> verify -> review -> audit -> publish, run by belt_attempt_obligations_run in the attempt's own unit (belt_attempt_obligations_cli); whether each is outstanding is DERIVED from the attempt's receipts (WorkflowAttemptProgress segments), never stored; a failed/refused stage stops that attempt's line until an operator resumes. Capture: the worker leaves .gunbc-submission.json (gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_submission); the belt commits and captures it; only a candidate (submission_candidacy) advances. Verify: belt_verify_attempt_for_instance / belt_verify_run_and_persist runs the node's declared validations at the exact head and writes a VerificationReceipt (gunbc.roadmap_verification_receipt, roadmap-verification-receipt/v2; six-field subject: node identity, criteria_digest, attempt, branch, head_sha, change_window_identity) plus the CurrentVerificationSelection pointer the dashboard reads. Review: gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_review_function plans one harness reviewer per design criterion (dispatch_review_unit_command -> harness_reviewer_cli) and aggregates verdict files; audit: goal audit (harness_auditor_cli). Publish: the attempt's unit writes a typed publication REQUEST; gunbc.roadmap_publication_helper (its own principal, own timer at the belt cadence) opens the PR against dispatch_base_branch(instance) (main on srv1); the receipt is final only when publication_receipt_offers_the_expected_head (one PR per work item). Integration: belt_integrate_candidate_core_for_instance merges a verified candidate into the project envelope (native SCM) with a per-head integration receipt. Result return (gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_result_returned, instance obligation): for an attempt in a FINAL handoff state it appends ResultReturned{attempt, claim, outcome} to the issue's event log, outcome ResultPublished{pr, head} | ResultVerificationFailed{head, cause} | ResultHandedBack{reason}, addressed to the claim's return_to. ACCEPTANCE: a merged PR never completes a node (node_is_accepted = signoff_accepts(n.signoff)); acceptance is an AcceptanceRecorded{RoadmapAcceptanceReceipt} event appended to the in-repo JSONL dag/gunbc/roadmap/roadmap_acceptance_event_history.jsonl (gunbc.roadmap_acceptance_history_carrier), replayed by roadmap_authority_projection, with integrity checked against the merge-base prefix (gunbc.roadmap_acceptance_history_observation); the receipt requires RedControlExecuted{witness_module, witness_fn, executed_on} + HandbackDelivered{first_artifact,...} + as_expected (gunbc.roadmap_status Signoff). No serve route or CLI constructs AcceptanceRecorded, so acceptance lands as a repository edit (operator sign-off by PR), after which the frontier recomputes and the child becomes Ready.

5. WHAT "DAILY" REFERS TO. Neither the cadence nor a snapshot. It is the product name of the operator's working surface: deployment id "srv1-daily-workspace" (gunbc.deployment_risk srv1_daily_workspace_deployment, the prod role holder), the page title "gunbc — daily workspace" (gunbc.roadmap_page, archetype Operational: leads with the frontier), and the served-observation kind DailyPage whose body the tick writes (receipts/served-observation-daily_page.body). Origin: docs/plans/roadmap-workspace-ux-plan.md "The roadmap as a daily workspace" (operator 2026-07-24: "I need to be able to actually work out of this soon"). origin/roadmap-daily exists (tip 2026-09-17, far diverged) and test/main-plus-roadmap-daily is only the srv2-deploy instance's dispatch_base_ref; neither is read by the belt.

6. LIVE STATE ON SRV1 (ssh, 2026-10-09 ~21:17Z). The deployed belt unit still runs belt_run_once_cli (description "one reconcile pass over the ready frontier"), receipt schema v6, deployed_revision 19b12d88 — one generation behind this worktree's belt_launch_enqueue_cli emission; no exit-drain/discovery/path units are installed. Every tick's spawn_pass AND teardown_pass are refused: "live session set could not be observed: the durable attempt records are unobservable ... attempt <10 keys>: the launch record could not be read ... No such file or directory"; and the service exits 1 on "result return could not run (events/snapshot): worktree-add ... fatal: could not create leading directories of '/opt/gunbc/roadmap-events/.git': Permission denied". The one running attempt (ci-executed-coverage-receipt-closing-contract) is a harness worker whose vLLM backend returned a 500. So today the dashboard's dispatch path is structurally complete but the live instance is refusing on the session-census and result-return legs.

DIMENSION: how a design/plan is modeled and linked in gunbc (worktree /home/briansrls/.worktrees/gunbc/smart-gull-336, read-only).

A. THE CARRIER. A plan is one `.dag` module under dag/gunbc/plans/ that declares one `data <name>_plan: Plan` row (authority `gunbc.plan`). `Plan { slug, title, body: List<MarkdownBlock>, retirement: PlanRetirement, projection: PlanProjection }`. The body is authored as typed markdown blocks (`std.markdown`) through the tiny constructor set in `gunbc.plans.md_helpers` (h1/h2/h3, p, li, li_blocks, ul, ol, cell, row, quote, tasks, todo, task, hr); there is no plan-specific carrier for milestones, triggers, consumers, acceptance or status -- those are PROSE inside blocks, by convention a leading `quote(...)` status block, then numbered `h2` sections, and (in program-shaped plans) one `h3` per milestone with paragraphs headed "Makes true / Deletes in the same change / Production consumer / Qualification / Exit", and decisions as `ol` items each ending "Ruled <date>" or "Deferred: trigger is ...". The two typed facts on a plan are: (1) `retirement: PlanRetiresWhen { condition: DissolutionCondition } | PlanHasNoRetirement` where `std.dissolution` `DissolutionCondition = BoundDissolution { trigger: DeclarationAppears{ref} | DeclarationRetires{ref} } | UnboundDissolution { description: NonEmptyStr }` -- every one of the 72 plans uses `PlanRetiresWhen { condition: unbound_dissolution(description: "...") }`, none uses a bound (machine-checkable) trigger, so `dissolution_status` can only ever answer `DissolutionUnbound` for a plan; (2) `projection: PlanProjectsCommittedMarkdown | PlanProjectsDerivedMarkdown { derive: fn() -> PlanDerivation } | PlanIsAuthorityOnly { ruling: String }` -- the plan itself decides whether docs/plans/<slug>.md is expected on disk; `PlanIsAuthorityOnly.ruling` carries the commit that deleted the projection (e.g. v2_corpus_self_host names a295e17415). "What does not retire" is likewise prose: e.g. demand_engine_program's retirement says "a terminal NativeProductionRefused is evidence and never dissolves this plan" and its 2.9 says E2/E4/M3a "each delete part of ... none ... retires the row". Two newer plans (gunbc.plans.v2_corpus_self_host `v2_corpus_self_host_ratchet_bindings`, gunbc.plans.import_namespace_program) add a `List<DeclarationRef>` roster of `decl_ref(module_path:, decl_name:)` so the claims that matter are joined to symbols the ingestion-time citation wall resolves (per the modules' own annotations); demand_engine_program imports a typed census module (gunbc.plans.demand_restatement_follow_up: `DemandRestatementRetainedRow { module_path, declaration, alias, authored_type, trigger: RetainedRowTrigger }` and `demand_restatement_follow_up_commit_range`) and renders those rows into its D13 follow-up item via `join`, which is the only place a plan body is derived from typed data rather than literals, besides PlanProjectsDerivedMarkdown (one user: dag_v2_defork_audit, deriving from gunbc.defork_type_name_census `defork_census_derivation`, which runs only where bytes are generated and refuses the artifact if the derivation refuses).

B. PROJECTION PIPELINE. `gunbc.plan_registry` `all_plans` = [idea_machine_plan] ++ batch_b..batch_g (`gunbc.plan_registry_batch_<x>` `batch_<x>_plans`, each a literal list of imported `*_plan` rows) = 65 rostered plans; 7 plan modules declare a Plan row but are in no batch (affected_set_self_confirmation, branch_merge_admission_model, fleet_subsumption_manual_gaps, host_convergence_circuit_residue, merge_admission_gate_shape_proposal, transport_argv_anemia_dissolution, wave2_prep_design -- all PlanIsAuthorityOnly), so they are generated by nothing and checked by no plan witness. `gunbc.generated_artifact_registry` `generated_artifact_registry` maps every rostered plan to `PlanArtifact { plan }`; `gunbc.generated_artifact` gives it `artifact_location` = `plan_doc_directory` ("docs/plans") + `plan_doc_name(slug)` and `artifact_commit_policy` = CommitRequired{ProjectDocumentation} for Committed/Derived, NotCommitted for AuthorityOnly, producer = decl_ref(gunbc.plan, plan_generation). Bytes: `gunbc.plan` `plan_generation` -> `plan_generation_admitted` -> `plan_markdown` -> `plan_to_blocks` = [H1 title] ++ governed-by banner ++ governs list ++ body ++ derived ++ `plan_retirement_blocks` (an `## Dissolution trigger (DESIGN §6)` heading plus `dissolution_description(condition)`), serialized by extdeps.languages.markdown `serialize_markdown_source`. `gunbc.generated_artifact_emit` `artifact_generate` consumes plan_generation for PlanArtifact. The drift gate is `tools.generated_artifact_gate` (dag/gunbc/instruments/generated_artifact_gate.dag): `main` adjudicates committed bytes vs regenerated, `main_wet` writes every `committed_generated_artifacts()` projection, `main_wet_verified` writes then verifies; bound in gunbc.ci.ci_spec as `gunbc_ci_heal_regen_target` / `gunbc_ci_heal_verify_target` / `gunbc_ci_heal_regen_verified_target`; on the required path it is `RequiredCiPhase` `GeneratedArtifactPhase` (gunbc.required_ci_phase_roster) in the BuildLane (`claim_executor --required-ci --required-lane build`). The separate `tools.docs_projection_gate` (`docs_projection_producer`) answers `Absent` for PlanArtifact and only covers directory "docs", so plans are NOT its population. Witnesses: test.claim.plan_lens_witness (SubstrateInputsOnly, runs on the floor) proves every registered plan has a nonempty retirement description and a title, and that PlanIsAuthorityOnly is not a committed-markdown root; test.claim.plan_governance_witness (SubstrateInputsOnly) proves the governance graph is admitted (root is a registered plan with no governor; every row names two registered plans; every governed plan reaches the root; cycle/orphan/two-parents/same-parent-twice/root-with-governor/hidden-cycle controls). The 21 committed projections on disk are the 21 Committed/Derived plans (budget-tree ... v2-self-hosting); the other 83 docs/plans/*.md are hand-authored (62 bound as `gunbc.doc_graph_roots` `HandAuthoredDocBind { home: PlanDoc|ProbeDoc, slug, primary_work: DeclarationRef, additional_works, dissolution: PlanRetirement }`, every one retiring; the rest reachable only via links or orphan).

C. HOW A PLAN IS LINKED. Four mechanisms, all distinct: (1) `gunbc.plan_governance` `plan_governance_rows` -- the ONE authored relation ("governed_by", roles CompilerStageAuthority | CompilerStageSpecialization | CrossCuttingLensAuthority | ImplementationProgram, `stage: String`), keyed on slug, admitted into an `AdmittedPlanGovernanceGraph sole_constructor` only when functional/rooted/acyclic/complete; today two rows: demand-engine-program and ensure-closure-design governed by root `compiler_architecture_root_slug` = "v2-compiler-architecture"; `plan_generation` refuses every projection when the graph is inadmissible. ROADMAP.md (a RoadmapArtifact) renders those paths (35 links to compiler-guarantee-recovery-gap-analysis.md, 13 to demand-engine-program.md, ...). (4) The worker-facing "plan" is NOT a docs/plans document: `RoadmapNode.centering: NonEmptyStr?` ("the near-complete plan: exact target files, the exemplar to imitate, the expected oracle shape, the acceptance command pattern", gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_centering) is a dispatch prerequisite; gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_readiness names `GapCentering` = "no centering plan: the row supplies no plan for a worker", and `dispatch_centering_preamble` is prepended to every brief.
